rationales.authenticity: Precise period medical knowledge (regular pains, water breaking, back aching as signs), Irish idiom ('the bawn's turning'), and 'Go raibh maith agat'.
rationales.character: Expert midwife providing specific, confident guidance with appropriate concern and warmth for expectant father.
rationales.craft: Slightly long but specific, evocative details about labor signs justify the length; minor craft excess.
rationales.language: Excellent English-Irish blend with proper grammar and authentic dialectal speech.
rationales.responsiveness: Thoroughly addresses when to fetch the midwife with detailed criteria and follow-up care questions.
